title: Shinonome Ena — New Year's At The Shinonomes〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yawn... I'm so sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Same... Yaaawn!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But you actually managed to get up early.
I mean, it's only 7...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I can get up early if I have to.
I set my alarm's volume to max.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The truth is, I only woke up because Akito stormed into my room, snatched the blankets and told me to turn my alarm off...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, you turned down my invite to hang out just because it was cold, but you're dragging me along shopping today.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You could've said no. Besides, if we had to wait in a line outside, I wouldn't have come either.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But you line up indoors for this, and the stores I want to go to are all conveniently located near each other.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmph. So you come here for the New Year's sales every year?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: By the way, we need to come up with a plan.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You mean, plan out which stores to go to?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. I want the grab bags from this store and the ones on the second floor. As much as I want to check out accessories and stuff, the cosmetics grab bags are my top priority.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I want to see a few apparel shops on the second floor too, so we can go together.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No accessories?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. It's not that I'm not interested, but it's no biggie. I could definitely use more cosmetics, so I'm going for those too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay. We still need to think about where each of us has to go after this one.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. We gotta be efficient to get everything we want before it's all gone♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, hey. They should be opening soon.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're right. Time really flies when you're strategizing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Everyone waiting looks so excited too.
I'm starting to get pretty excited!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience!
We are now starting our grab bag sales!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Finally!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Got our first one♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Cool! I'll go to the next place on our list!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay! Let me know if anything happens!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
The third store on our list is...
Here! The one Mizuki wanted!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Great, they still have their white outfit sets too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, got it. Next is...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? A message? Maybe it's from Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <They're running out of everything M-sized at the store you like!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No way! They didn't sell this fast last year!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Forget the cosmetics! See if you can still get anything in M for me!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You got it♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Mizuki, you're my only hope.
Alright, next for me is...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki...! I'm over here!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Looks like we got everything we wanted!
Now, let's check out the spoils♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hold on. This is an M bag, right?
Why is there L-sized stuff mixed in...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha. Bummer!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This isn't funny! Ugh... That store's too far to go bother asking for an exchange...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Why don't you give the ones that are too big for you to Mafuyu? They'd suit her.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're right... But do you think she'd want them?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Who knows? Dang, this white dress would look better on Miku than me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ena, can we go over to SEKAI for a bit?
Mafuyu might just be there too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now...?
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hello, Ena and Mizuki. I wasn't expecting you today...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Just a spur-of-the-moment, you know...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're carrying lots of bags... Are we having another party?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, not today...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Mafuyu and Kanade are here...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, Ena and Mizuki are here too...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We went to New Year's sales and a dress I got from a grab bag seems perfect for Miku, so we came to see her!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What about you, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I got a New Year's decoration as a freebie from a convenience store. I thought Miku might like it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A New Year's decoration?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's just something you usually put by the door...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And you...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We had a family gathering. It ended, so I came here...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, okay. But you look even gloomier than usual...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, anyway... Wanna see what clothes we got? It might cheer you up.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No thanks...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But the M-sized grab bag had L-sized stuff mixed in. Can you believe it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No need to show me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Come on, it won't hurt to take a look! Here!
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Phew... I'm spent.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why does Mafuyu have to make things so difficult? That dress was made for her and she just flat out refused...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? A message? Maybe it's from Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <A belated Happy New Year, Ena!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's from Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And Happy New Year to you! I'm looking forward to our shopping trips this year too!>
